promotion_rule: The same tested Operator must receive explicit user acceptance in three distinct situations.

user_promotion_progress.meaning: portfolio-level accepted proof count; not sufficient for Operator promotion

cycles.situation: Same-session two-person lupine field material with relationship, tactile flower, and person-presence roles.
User nature clips from separate shoots: forest, stream, grass, robin, and sunset birds.
cycles.learned_gate: Motif continuity does not establish session continuity.

cycles.situation: One unedited 30.24-second portrait take with a complete reach, return, and flower-action progression.
cycles.learned_gate: State cuts preserve motion direction or pose geometry and never reset an object backward.

cycles.situation: Same-session two-person lupine field material; action detail expands into relationship blocking and returns to the shared field.
cycles.promotion_note: This reuses the same source situation as functional-memory-panels-v002 and therefore cannot count as a distinct promotion situation.

cycles.situation: One licensed, unedited candle take: active flame, weakening, collapse, and tiny ember.
cycles.learned_gate: Absence needs a visible inherited trace; near-pure black is not enough.

cycles.situation: One licensed, unedited fixed beach take with a right-to-left frame exit and native moving water afterward.
cycles.learned_gate: Correct motion direction does not excuse large spatial jumps; one-second walking skips can still read as a lurch.

cycles.situation: The same licensed fixed beach take, rebuilt with near-contiguous walking ranges and more time on the native empty-water consequence.
cycles.promotion_note: This supersedes v002 but uses the same source situation, so the pair can never count as two promotion situations.

cycles.situation: One licensed, unedited fixed overhead latte-art take in which the same cup develops through more than five material states.
cycles.learned_gate: A large time jump can remain legible when a stable spatial anchor persists and the visible material state advances monotonically.

cycles.situation: One licensed fixed beach take rendered with frame-identical plain and proof timelines; only two evidence-bound semantic sentences differ.
cycles.learned_gate: Copy passes only when it is readable, names a visible state, and changes observation into a chapter or proposition without sticker-like decoration.

cycles.situation: One licensed perfume-use take reordered from object-first display into chronological spray, wrist response, and bottle recovery in a fixed 9:16 crop.
cycles.learned_gate: Ritual-first sequence order cannot earn a full advertising pass when the source lacks a readable label, claim, or isolated brand recovery.

cycles.situation: Three licensed unedited shots from one lupine-field session, ordered so real flower shadow and purple foreground texture move from fabric to hand to flower contact to face.
cycles.learned_gate: A luminous relay passes only when the same visible phenomenon changes carriers across cuts; palette similarity or generic sunlight is insufficient.
cycles.scope_limit: Validates direct sunlight, flower shadow, and foreground floral occlusion in one session; it does not validate reflection, glass, lens flare, night light, or mixed-location bridges.

cycles.situation: Three licensed unedited shots from one evening picnic session, ordered from tactile table detail to wine-pour action owner to individual laughter and a four-person toast relationship field.
cycles.learned_gate: Each distance must add a distinct information role, and the destination canvas must preserve the complete relationship or environment coverage rather than deleting it with a cover crop.
cycles.scope_limit: Validates one coherent landscape friendship session; it does not validate mixed locations, native 9:16 group coverage, product advertising, music synchronization, or decorative in-frame layouts.

cycles.situation: One licensed continuous park take compressed through contact, separation, reconvergence, lift, running, and a purported empty-path ending.
cycles.learned_gate: Chronological state labels do not excuse skipping the physical hinge; a performer still crossing frame cannot be called empty space.

cycles.situation: The same licensed continuous park take rebuilt so contact, separation, reconvergence, lift, carry, shared running, exit, and true empty path develop without relationship-state reset.
cycles.learned_gate: Relationship states must develop monotonically, and the physical hinge that transfers action ownership should remain near-contiguous even if the result must breathe longer.
cycles.scope_limit: Validates one playful camera-followed pair; conflict, reconciliation, family hierarchy, locked-off staging, native vertical coverage, advertising, and music remain untested.

cycles.situation: Three licensed unedited takes from one urban-park pair session, arranged as hand cause, progressively revealed shared-presence, intimate-exchange and place panels, then full-frame reconvergence and lift.
cycles.learned_gate: Every panel needs a named non-substitutable information role, and the completed field must release to one stronger live image that restores withheld body, action, object, or spatial information.
cycles.scope_limit: Validates one same-session landscape urban pair; unrelated footage, product grids, native vertical layout, typography, and music remain untested.

cycles.situation: One licensed unedited interior take with chronological curtain contact, opening, light arrival, and lit release, overlaid with two evidence-bound copy clauses in a heavy all-caps serif treatment.
cycles.learned_gate: Semantic relevance and readability do not rescue typography that dominates the scene; copy weight, case, and shadow must remain subordinate to the visual evidence.

cycles.situation: The same licensed unedited interior take with frame-identical plain and proof variants, using restrained lowercase copy only during the dark-curtain and post-light-arrival states.
cycles.learned_gate: Copy must pass separate semantic and visual-hierarchy gates: show it only when the named state is visible, and keep its treatment quieter than the action that proves it.
cycles.scope_limit: Validates one solitary interior light-change situation; dialogue, group action, brand claims, Korean typography, dense montage, and music remain untested.

cycles.situation: One licensed unedited locked tea-service take compressed into untouched cup, pot arrival, pour onset, sustained pour, release, and a later hand-delivered service detail.
cycles.learned_gate: A matched stream does not justify deleting the pot that owns it; preserve the physical release hinge rather than allowing an object-body lurch.
cycles.scope_limit: The opaque cup hides fill level, so motif-state-return cannot earn an independent pass from this source.

cycles.situation: The same licensed unedited locked tea-service take rebuilt with source-contiguous pot arrival, pour body and release, followed by compression of only the inactive hold before service completion.
cycles.learned_gate: Compress inactivity, not the object that owns the action; preserve the causal hinge near-contiguously even when the edit must run longer.
cycles.scope_limit: Validates one locked object ritual; handheld action, multi-angle coverage, branded recovery, relationships, and music remain untested. The opaque cup prevents a full motif-state pass.

cycles.situation: One licensed unedited locked take in which a stable blue-white-orange-red refracted band moves from wall to fingertips, palm, turning hand, a near-camera two-hand interception, and open palm.
cycles.learned_gate: A real luminous carrier does not excuse a body-scale lurch; the destination must keep the light readable rather than replace it with a dominant near-camera silhouette.
cycles.scope_limit: The source supports a real wall-to-skin optical relay, but this edit fails at its final scale and occlusion boundary.

cycles.situation: The same licensed unedited locked rainbow take rebuilt around empty wall, fingertips, palm, stable hand turn, two-hand interception, and an open-palm release that preserves the refracted carrier.
cycles.learned_gate: Name the optical phenomenon and carrier at every state, then reject any boundary whose occlusion or scale change makes that carrier less readable at the destination.
cycles.scope_limit: Validates one locked single-take wall-to-skin rainbow/refraction branch; water reflection, night light, moving camera, mixed locations, mixed orientation, and music remain untested.

cycles.situation: Two licensed unedited same-session locked takes containing a complete Nutella lid opening, an open-jar smell response, and a later steady front-label hold under changing television light.
cycles.learned_gate: Separate product presence, explicit product emphasis, and brand recovery: a readable label may complete the last branch while preventing a strong product-delay claim.
cycles.scope_limit: Validates a branded locked food-smell ritual only; the label is visible from the first frame, the closing action is inferred, and hidden reveal, claims, moving camera, social context, music, and endorsement remain untested.

cycles.situation: The same licensed same-session Nutella ritual rebuilt with a longer closed-eye smell response and a concise blue-violet front-label recovery matched to the preceding television-light world.
cycles.learned_gate: Match the brand recovery to the sensory peak's light world and hold it only long enough for recognition; a longer passive label hold can weaken the close.
cycles.scope_limit: Improves the branded recovery of one locked food-smell ritual, but the always-readable label, inferred closure, absent claim, moving-camera gap, music gap, and endorsement restriction keep the full Operator unvalidated.

cycles.situation: One user-provided unedited locked telephoto take of a robin turning, settling, holding a readable profile, turning away, returning, and leaving the perch.
cycles.learned_gate: A density change counts only when the longer or shorter region reveals a more readable behavior, action, place, relationship, or tactile function.
cycles.scope_limit: The locked single composition provides behavior states but no scale, environment, relationship, or tactile change; without reviewed audio the central vocal hold is visually subtle, so the general semantic-density-hinge remains unvalidated.

cycles.situation: Seven unedited single-take fragments from one coherent flower-field session provide environment, tactile flower-pocket action, photography action, embodied arm-raise reaction, and native running release.
cycles.user_verdict_evidence: User response after reviewing the comparison: 'ㅇㅇ 괜찮은데' followed by '일단 ㄱㄱ'.

audio_decision.reason: This accepted visual proof predates the user's conditional permission for licensed public music and isolates visual duration grammar.

cycles.learned_gate: A semantic-density hinge must add distinct place, tactile, action-owner, embodied-response or destination information; the longer hold begins at the first frame where the central action becomes legible, not at an arbitrary rhythmic count.
cycles.scope_limit: Research-validates one same-session, one-person flower-field branch without audio, relationship, face-closeup or restrained Haku-grade image authorship; the user accepted this situation, so density-wave-release is 1/3 and still needs two materially different approvals.
